factors.name: Walk-forward calibration
factors.note: 120 prior games; future results excluded

rationale: Model projects WSH 81.6 – ATL 89.0. Opponent-adjusted scoring, pace/efficiency, venue form, travel, schedule density and role-weighted availability are included. No wager is rated until a real market price is available.
